_comment: P5-001 (plan-living-memory-slice-1): labeled recall eval dataset. Corpus records are drawn from this repo's real history (docs/incidents/*, docs/plans/*, the memory index). Each query is a natural-language prompt an operator/agent might type, labeled with the corpus id(s) that SHOULD be recalled. ageDays/importance are set to exercise recency+importance shaping. Used by recall-eval.test.ts to compare hybrid (FTS+recency+importance+RRF) vs a pure-BM25 baseline.

corpus.title: login fail-fast when there is no terminal
corpus.detail: massu login honored neither MASSU_API_KEY nor bounded non-TTY stdin, so non-interactive/piped login could hang forever. Fix: env-first resolveLoginKey with a 2s bounded 64KB-capped stdin read, fail-closed. The plan's unguarded-prompt hypothesis was false (already isTTY-guarded).

corpus.title: validate-key edge function 500 on every real key was deploy drift
corpus.detail: The deployed Supabase edge bundle was stale (async compare worker crash) five weeks after source was fixed. Not a bcrypt bug. Fixed by redeploy plus CR-60 deploy-verify drift-guard and Guardian watcher.

corpus.title: Node 26 broke massu via better-sqlite3 native ABI mismatch
corpus.detail: engines allowed <26 and better-sqlite3 was built for ABI 127, so the native module was dead on the default Node 26 runtime. Fixed by bumping better-sqlite3 and a Node-major CI matrix plus node-compat drift guard.

corpus.title: git-safe user-level API key resolution via credentials.ts
corpus.detail: Single resolver credentials.ts with precedence config > MASSU_API_KEY env > ~/.massu/credentials, default endpoint api.massu.ai/v1. Fixed the case where a key was set but doctor still reported Free because there was no default endpoint to validate against.

corpus.title: signup confirmation email not delivered — throttled default sender
corpus.detail: Supabase Auth on the throttled default email sender plus a stale Site URL. Fixed via config.toml Resend SMTP and config push; signup 200 and canonical host redirect verified.

corpus.title: real v8 coverage gate with monotonic coverage floors
corpus.detail: Replaced the filename heuristic with real @vitest/coverage-v8 line percentage checked against coverage-floors.json (core 80, website/src/lib 92). Three-layer drift prevention.

corpus.title: enterprise governance and signed audit export
corpus.detail: Org N-of-M promotion policy plus Ed25519 signed audit-export with a flat records_json envelope; migration 049. Pending edge secret AUDIT_EXPORT_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_B64.

corpus.title: curated rule packs materialize as signed reviewable candidates
corpus.detail: Packs become signed candidates that require approval before apply; migrations 047/048 and an installed-rules edge function.

corpus.title: edge function verify_jwt must be false for API-key functions
corpus.detail: Any Supabase edge function that authenticates ms_live_ keys itself must declare verify_jwt=false in config.toml or the platform JWT gateway 401s every API-key request. CR-58.

corpus.title: Supabase prod migration drift — missing migrations 033-043
corpus.detail: The schema_migrations ledger was fiction after a baseline restore. Never blind db push (it re-runs down.sql forward). Target the prod project ref explicitly; the CLI defaults to the wrong org.

corpus.title: public repo leak guard and sister-repo sync policy
corpus.detail: massu-ai/massu is public; PUBLIC_MANIFEST.md governs what syncs. Internal-only references must never leak to the public website content.

corpus.title: pre-push must mirror CI parity (CR-50)
corpus.detail: Every multi-line workflow shell block must live in scripts/ci-*.sh and be called from pre-push-light or carry an explicit CI-ONLY opt-out. Three-layer enforcement.

corpus.title: old login prompt copy tweak
corpus.detail: A very old cosmetic change to the login command help text. Low importance, stale. Shares the login keyword but is not the fail-fast decision.

corpus.title: config upgrade caused data loss on migration
corpus.detail: A config upgrade path dropped keys during migration across repos; recovered with zero key loss after fixing the merge-refresh nesting.

corpus.title: changelog single source of truth drift guard
corpus.detail: The website parses CHANGELOG.md at build; bump EXPECTED_COUNT and version sync after every release entry.

corpus.title: .mcp.json must pin the @massu/core version
corpus.detail: An unversioned npx -y resolves a stale global; bump the pin every release.

corpus.title: CLAUDE.md size gate with autosplit to reference detail
corpus.detail: An enforced max size at pre-push and CI; over-budget content moves to .claude/reference/canonical-rules-detail.md.

corpus.title: auto-learning requires Pro tier — structural gate
corpus.detail: Candidate emission and rule promotion are gated at a single chokepoint reading one entitlement source of truth, fail-closed to Free on any tier-resolution error. CR-54.

corpus.title: team-shared rule promotion approval-before-apply
corpus.detail: A promoted rule propagates org-wide as a reviewable proposal the receiving operator must approve; shareable-destination allowlist; Ed25519 envelope verification. CR-55.

corpus.title: signed envelope nested-array forgery pitfall
corpus.detail: A sorted-key replacer strips nested bodies, opening a forgery hole. Sign a flat envelope with the array serialized as a *_json string; use ensure_ascii false in Python.

corpus.title: SSRF blocklist must cover IPv4-mapped IPv6
corpus.detail: A DNS-time blocklist must handle both ::ffff:dotted and ::ffff:hex-pair forms for each reserved range.

corpus.title: always use eko-guardian for scheduled tasks
corpus.detail: Recurring or future checks go through the Guardian Python plus plist, not /schedule or bare cron.

corpus.title: watcher rolling-window buffer over cadence
corpus.detail: A watcher window must be at least cadence plus skew plus DST plus jitter; a daily 17:00 check needs a 26h window, not 24h.
